purpose: the residue-identity rule and what it costs, measured
rule: a residue is (chain, resseq); the insertion code and the alternate-location indicator are not part of its identity
why: CryptoBench labels are bare integers, so a finer key would create residues no label can mark positive
recall_denominator: labelled residues present in the apo structure; a residue with no coordinates is outside every method's universe and is neither a hit nor a miss
